title: Отчёт laravel-env: redirect-query
value:
Redirects now append `$is_args$args` unless the target sets a
query of its own. Existing redirects pick it up on the next re-render or the
next `redirect-add`.

title: Отчёт laravel-env: static-charset
value:

title: Отчёт laravel-env: charset-migration-guard
value:
`self migrate` (run by `self update`) adds the setting to static sites
created by 1.17.0-1.17.2: once per site, after a backup of the config and an
`nginx -t` check; a failing site is restored and reported.

title: Отчёт laravel-env: persistent-node-state
value:
Node services (profile `node`) get `SIMAI_STATE_DIR=<site root>/shared/state`
in their unit: a directory outside releases, owned by the site user, that
survives deploys and rollbacks.

source_spans.quote:

title: Отчёт laravel-env: existing-node-adoption
value:
Existing node services pick the variable up on their next deploy or
`site service-restart`.

source_spans.quote:
Existing node services pick the variable up on their next deploy or

title: Отчёт laravel-env: static-plus-api
value:
Applications that ship a static build plus an API (the SIMAI playground) run
as one node site: nginx serves the build, the service answers only its
routes, and every path keeps the headers and caching the application needs.

source_spans.quote:

title: Отчёт laravel-env: routes-validation-rollback
value:
Deploys and rollbacks render the routes of the release being switched and
  run `nginx -t` before the switch is kept; a failing release returns to the
  previous one together with its routes.

source_spans.quote:
Deploys and rollbacks render the routes of the release being switched and

title: Отчёт laravel-env: old-node-proxy-compatibility
value:
Node sites created before 1.18 keep their inline proxy until their nginx
configuration is next rendered (for example by `ssl install`); they then get
the same proxy from a generated routes file.

source_spans.quote:

title: Отчёт laravel-env: path-allow-acme-persistence
value:
Exact files and prefixes ending in `/`; every other path answers 404 (ACME
challenges always pass). The list survives certificate changes and other
re-renders.

source_spans.quote:

title: Отчёт laravel-env: header-validation
value:
Every location repeats `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, because an
`add_header` in a location drops the server-level ones. Header values may not
contain `"`, `\`, `$` or braces; regexes may use `$` only as an anchor.

title: Отчёт laravel-env: verification-scope
value:

  fallback, `/api/` to the service with `API_PORT`/`API_HOST` and `{state}`,

  release header following the release, deny pattern, gzip, a disallowed
  header refused with the previous release still serving, routes kept after
  `ssl install`, cleanup on `site remove`.
